queries.sql: SELECT LOWER(TRIM(p.url_route)) AS url_route FROM administration.profil_permission AS pp INNER JOIN administration.permission AS p ON p.permission_id = pp.permission_id INNER JOIN administration.profil AS pr ON pr.profil_id = pp.profil_id WHERE pp.profil_id = 1 AND pp.is_active = TRUE AND p.is_active = TRUE AND (pr.is_active IS NULL OR pr.is_active = TRUE) ORDER BY 1
